# Virtual network peering

One direction of a peering, from an existing virtual network to another one. A working peering needs both directions.

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-readme.sh from the compiled template. Edit the @description and @metadata decorators instead. -->

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | `1.0.0` |
| Use it | `module m… 'br/platform:modules/network/peering:v1.0.0' = { … }` |
| Deploys at | resource group scope |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|
| [pVnetName](#pvnetname) | yes | string |
| [pRemoteVnetId](#premotevnetid) | yes | string |
| [pAllowGatewayTransit](#pallowgatewaytransit) | no | bool |
| [pUseRemoteGateways](#puseremotegateways) | no | bool |

### pVnetName

Name of the existing virtual network the peering starts from, in the resource group this module deploys to.

- Type: string
- Example: `vnet-sampleapp-prod-szn-001`

### pRemoteVnetId

Resource ID of the virtual network on the other side.

- Type: string

### pAllowGatewayTransit

Let the other side use this network's gateway. Set on the hub side when the hub has a gateway.

- Type: bool
- Default: `false`

### pUseRemoteGateways

Use the gateway of the other side. Set on the spoke side when the hub has a gateway; never for Entra Domain Services.

- Type: bool
- Default: `false`

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| oName | string | Name of the peering. |
